protocol.name: Phase 15-A2 frozen occupancy accumulation comparison
protocol.source: research/results/phase15a/summary.json and its recorded depth replay
protocol.numeric_representation: Exact integer hundredths, algebraically identical fixed log-odds; strict >85 threshold
protocol.evidence_unit: One update per cell per actual captured frame; occupied wins over free in that frame; V2 counts distinct occupied frames, cumulative not consecutive
protocol.rays: Integer Bresenham at nearest 1cm cells. Height-valid hits: free interior, occupied endpoint if within occupied range. Floor z<=0.03: entire ray including endpoint free. Surfaces at 2..3m for V3/V4: free interior, endpoint observed but no log-odds update. Points above 0.6m or beyond 3m produce no rays, preserving the old height/max-range input filter. No extrapolation beyond measured endpoints.
protocol.unknown: V1..4: no ray ever visited cell. Unknown contributes no occupancy. V0 retains original horizontal visibility semantics exactly.
protocol.sdf: Same EDT, radius 0.09, bilinear query/gradient, h/sqrt(2) bound, empty-field convention, path sampling and safety threshold as Phase15-A
protocol.noise: Both none/gaussian; exact same per-run/frame SeedSequence and float16 inputs as Phase15-A
protocol.selection: Eligible if dangerous sample fraction <=0.02 AND update p95<=50ms. Minimize conservative fraction, tie lower variant number. Freeze selection before computing held-out metrics. If none, NO_VARIANT.
protocol.held_out: Only selected variant gets a decision label. All other held-out metrics are descriptive as requested and cannot change selection.
protocol.denominators: Dangerous/conservative fractions use all evaluated sample decisions; pooled updates for p95, not mean of per-run percentiles
protocol.execution_order: Selection split first, then held-out; index ascending, variant V0..V4, noise none then gaussian; serial CPU, no retries or tuning
protocol.v0_regression: Every saved sample clearance/decision/selection/unknown statistic and every frame's non-clock map statistics must exactly equal Phase15-A; wall-clock times are necessarily remeasured and reported next to the saved reference
protocol.timing: Same total and three components as Phase15-A; Bresenham/unique evidence/log-odds/counting included in accumulation. Native-kernel one-time compilation excluded and documented. Oracle diagnostics, disk I/O excluded. All frames included, no warmup discard.
protocol.unknown_risk: Per sample, original 5mm query convention (including duplicate vertices); count unknown queries whose exact oracle footprint clearance is <0.025m. Diagnostic only.
protocol.phantom: Noisy occupied lattice cells with exact oracle obstacle/corridor footprint clearance >0.20m. Per observation plus final/peak per run; independent run maps are not merged.
protocol.collision_cases: P13 GF39/GF45, originating FRESH of the path active at the saved collision, same switch as Phase15-A
protocol.plot_snapshot: Same Phase15-A spatial instant: GF index35, first switch B.x>=1.0; gaussian condition; V0 vs selected vs oracle
